data.narrative:
Zeta Surgical is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by Jose Amich, Raahil Sha, and William Gormley that has raised $9M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Only one valuation method proved applicable: Stage-Progression analysis. Using the $9M total capital raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $22M. This serves as the median point in the triangulated range.

The analysis supports a valuation band of $19M to $26M, with $22M as the central point. However, this range rests on a single method due to material data constraints. Private peer multiples could not be derived (no same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with sufficient density), and public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied without Zeta Surgical's revenue—data private companies typically do not disclose. Key uncertainties include the target's actual revenue run rate, development stage maturity relative to named peers, and the applicability of standard biotech step-up multiples to this specific frontier-tech application. Investors should treat this $19–26M range as indicative pending deeper operational and market diligence.
